claim: In the matching retail DLL, FormAnimator.InitAnmWork (0x06004E6C) is a parameterless 303-byte method with no branches and no method calls. It initializes FormAnimator fields to reqAnmInit=1, InitialAnmIdx=0, OpponentInitialAnmIdx=1, FormDispDuration=0, FrameWait=0, isReqAnmLoopEnd=0, isAnmLooped=0, isAnmPause=0, isAnmSync=0, isCopiedOpponentDir=0, isAtkHitOff=0, isAnmBoot=0, isAttackHit=0, and isAttackHit2=0. Through plObj it writes FoxSleepCnt=192 and clears ChangeRefereeGiveUpAnm, isCriticalMove, isSpecialMove, isVibratePlayer, isPinfallAtk, isPinfallDef, isSubmissionAtk, isSubmissionDef, isIgnoreTerrainCol, isFoul, isPossibleFoxSleep, isDecDownTime, isPossibleToGrapple, and isWannaGiveUp to zero, then stores Status3 = Status3 & -9 and returns. The already-closed ReqBasicAnm and ordinary ReqSlotAnm paths call this exact method at their pinned DLL call sites.
